title: The coefficient change of the identity
statement:
For every condensed abelian group $\Lambda$ (in particular every condensed ring) and every scheme
$X$, the coefficient change of the identity is the identity:
$(\mathrm{id}_\Lambda)_X=\mathrm{id}_{\Lambda_X}$ ([def-sfb-coefficient-map]).
Here $\Lambda_X:=p_X^*\Lambda$ and $(\mathrm{id}_\Lambda)_X:=p_X^*(\mathrm{id}_\Lambda)$, where $p_X^*$ is the functor on condensed abelian groups of [sk-def-sfb-pullback-from-point], part 4. This extends the notation of [def-sfb-coefficient-map] from ring morphisms to the underlying abelian-group morphisms.
